# Editable sources of the README pictures

Generated by `tools/release` (media step) for BMM 1.0.2.

- `hero.svg`: the banner, layered (background, screenshot back/front, logo, title, tagline, version). Its screenshots are linked from `../`; fonts: Inter, fallback Segoe UI.
- `<name>.svg`: each screenshot as two layers, *screenshot* and *Tasky*, linked from `../layers/`.

Open them in Inkscape, Illustrator or Affinity (Photoshop imports SVG as one layer). Layered **PSD** files of every picture, self-contained, are in `Release/<version>/media/screenshots/source/` and `Release/<version>/media/source/` (not committed).
